en.title: Hormuz Traffic Surges
en.summary: The probability of 100+ ships transiting Hormuz surged to 92% due to concrete reports of high daily traffic and increased confidence. A BBC report cited 42 ships crossing on a recent Saturday, significantly boosting expectations for the June 22-28 period.
drivers: BBC reported 42 ships transited on a recent Saturday.
US efforts opening channels, boosting shipowner confidence.
Iran-Oman discussions on Hormuz transit administration.
en.why_matters: The Strait of Hormuz is a critical chokepoint for global oil and gas shipments, making its stability vital for energy markets and international trade. Increased transit indicates easing geopolitical tensions and improved supply chain reliability.
en.bull_case: Recent high daily transit numbers, like 42 ships on Saturday, strongly suggest 100+ vessels will cross within the week.
en.bear_case: Despite current optimism, security remains 'hour to hour,' and any unforeseen incident could quickly disrupt transit volumes.

drivers: BBC报道称近期周六有42艘船只通过。

zh.why_matters: 霍尔木兹海峡是全球石油和天然气运输的关键咽喉，其稳定对能源市场和国际贸易至关重要。通航量增加表明地缘政治紧张局势缓解及供应链可靠性提升。
zh.bull_case: 近期每日高通航量（如周六42艘）强烈预示本周内将有100艘以上船只通过。
zh.bear_case: 尽管目前乐观，但安全局势仍是“每小时都在变化”，任何突发事件都可能迅速中断通航量。
